Gurpreet Chatterjee
Senior Android Developer | Hyderabad
gurpreet.chatterjee802@example.com | +91 9213293606

Experienced Android developer focused on building performant, user-centric mobile apps using Kotlin and modern Android frameworks. Strong track record delivering features end-to-end, improving app stability and engagement through Jetpack Compose and Firebase-driven analytics. Available with a 15 days notice period.

NimbusSoft — Apr 2023 - Present
Android Developer — Hybrid

- Integrated Firebase Authentication and Firestore for a modular user profile system, supporting concurrent reads/writes and cutting data-sync latency by 35%.

- Optimized image loading and Compose rendering, improving average frame rendering time by 40% and reducing app memory usage on low-end devices.

Saffron Bank — Nov 2021 - Mar 2023
Mobile Engineer — Remote
- Built secure Android features in Kotlin for banking workflows, integrating Firebase Cloud Messaging to enable real-time transaction alerts with 99.6% delivery reliability.
- Collaborated on app stability improvements tracked in Jira, resolving high-priority defects and decreasing critical incidents by 47% over two quarters.
- Developed modular Android components to streamline onboarding and KYC flows, reducing development time for new screens by 30%.
- Implemented analytics via Firebase to measure feature adoption and A/B tests, guiding UI adjustments that increased retention for key cohorts by 12%.

Projects
- Personal Finance Tracker — Android app built in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose and Firebase backend for secure sync; implemented offline caching and push notifications for bill reminders.
